supportTitle: Please Support the Grier Museum & Library
supportIntro: To maintain the Grier Museum and Library we need both books and cash donations:
supportBooks:
We need BOOKS at all times to keep the Library well stocked. The books we have are of the highest quality and we want to maintain this standard. It is fair to say that there is no major or important book published in Western literature in the past 400 years that is not represented in our collection - from Shakespeare (3 different volumes of his Complete Works) and Chaucer (The Canterbury Tales) to Milton (Paradise Lost & Paradise Regained), Dickens (Tale of Two Cities, Great Expectations) and Thomas Hardy (The Mayor of Casterbridge). We have such rare original books as ‘The Origin of Species’ by Charles Darwin, Dante’s ‘Inferno’, ‘Das Kapital’ by Karl Marx (English translation ‘Capital’) and Leo Tolstoy’s ‘War and Peace.’ All major Nigerian writers are represented - Wole Soyinka, Chinua Achebe, Cyprian Ekwensi, Elechi Amadi and others. Also the historical classics like Wole Ademoyega’s ‘Why we struck’ and other Civil War epics like ‘Reluctant Rebel.’ We want our future fiction and historical book donations to approach this high standard.

This is a reference library for rare books not just for our students but for our old boys and other visitors. We also want to appeal to reputable bookshops in Nigeria to donate books that our children can use in the classroom and for test review and preparations for the Senior and Junior Secondary School certificate exams.
supportMoney:
And we always need cash donations because we are not just setting up a Museum and Library. Grier House is expanding the spectrum of extracurricular activities for its students in the following areas:

- Audiovisual learning system based in the library and museum, with computers, monitors, speakers and printers with WiFi connectivity
- Grier House Marching Band with trumpet, drums and other instruments to galvanize our boys and players during interhouse competitions - a first in GCI
- Mustard Seed editorial team
- Chess club
- Radio and digital music to be blared out from wall mounted speakers for Saturday night social nights and other social events in the Museum/Library and adjoining reading room (prep room)
- Board games for our students including Monopoly, Ludo, Draughts, Scrabble and our traditional ‘ayo.’
- Money for the upkeep, maintenance and replacement of Museum and Library equipment, books and supplies
